response.rationale: Biopsy-confbred VTC metastasis and the hypervascular thyroid/multifocal pattern with elevated thyroglobulin support a vascular thyroid tumor with metastasis. R4 is a generic fallback; R2 lacks papillary-specific evidence; R3 is contradicted by elevated thyroglobulin and iodine-avid metastases.

rejected.why: Medullary carcinoma is unsupported; elevated thyroglobulin and iodine-avid metastases favor a follicular-derived thyroid tumor, not C-cell medullary carcinoma.
No papillary subtype features are provided; biopsy explicitly indicates VTC, not papillary carcinoma.
